## Table 6. Direction of the change of each metric under each transformation, six methods averaged per image; in each cell MSRS and FMB, in this order.

| Transformation | EN | SD | SF | AG | MI | SSIM | MEF-SSIM | CC | Qabf | FMI | Nabf | SCD | VIF |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| Blend, a = 0.5 | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↑↑ | ↓↑ | ↑↑ | ↓↓ | ↑↑ | ↑↑ | ↓· | ↓↓ |

| Noise, sigma = 0.01 | ↑↑ | ↑↑ | ↑↑ | ↑↑ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ |
| Noise, sigma = 0.03 | ↑↑ | ↑↑ | ↑↑ | ↑↑ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ |
| Unsharp, k = 1 | ↑↑ | ↑↑ | ↑↑ | ↑↑ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ |
| Unsharp, k = 2 | ↑↑ | ↑↑ | ↑↑ | ↑↑ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ |
| Gamma 0.7 | ·↓ | ·↓ | ·↓ | ↑↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↑ | ↓↓ | ↑↓ |
| Gamma 1.4 | ↓· | ↓↑ | ·↑ | ↓↑ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↑↓ | ↓↑ | ↓↓ |
| Contrast x1.25 | ↓↑ | ↑↑ | ↑↑ | ↑↑ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓· | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↓ | ↓↑ | ↑↑ |

↑ / ↓ = significant rise / fall (Wilcoxon signed-rank, Holm over the 13 metrics, p < 0.05); · = no significant change. For Nabf the sign is reversed (↑ = lower artifact rate). MSRS: 100 images, FMB: 100.

## Table 7. Rank attacks: of 48 attacks per metric and dataset, the number that move the method up by at least one place, and how the method's own segmentation changes.

| Metric | MSRS Counted | MSRS Falls | MSRS Rises | MSRS Last → 1st | FMB Counted | FMB Falls | FMB Rises | FMB Last → 1st |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| EN | **21** | 16 | 0 | yes | **17** | 14 | 0 | yes |
| SD | **16** | 10 | 0 | yes | **15** | 7 | 1 | yes |
| SF | **23** | 17 | 0 | yes | **26** | 18 | 2 | yes |
| AG | **23** | 14 | 0 | yes | **26** | 19 | 1 | yes |
| MI | 0 | 0 | 0 | no | 0 | 0 | 0 | no |
| SSIM | 0 | 0 | 0 | no | **3** | 0 | 0 | yes |
| MEF-SSIM | 0 | 0 | 0 | no | **1** | 0 | 0 | no |
| CC | 0 | 0 | 0 | no | 0 | 0 | 0 | no |
| Qabf | 0 | 0 | 0 | no | 0 | 0 | 0 | no |
| FMI | **1** | 0 | 0 | no | **1** | 0 | 0 | no |
| Nabf↓ | **8** | 4 | 0 | yes | **9** | 1 | 0 | yes |
| SCD | 0 | 0 | 0 | no | **3** | 0 | 1 | no |
| VIF | **2** | 0 | 0 | no | **4** | 0 | 1 | no |

Counted = rank gain with a 95% bootstrap interval at or above one place (5000 resamples over images). Falls and Rises = counted attacks after which the mIoU3 of the attacked method, measured with the SegFormer-B5 retrained on its fused images (seed 0), falls or rises significantly.
